d: Some careers prize diversity more than others.
If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.

HSBC aims to be the international bank of choice for affluent customers, supporting their domestic and international banking, and holistic wealth management needs. We help customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors and entrepreneurs around the world.

Manager – Customer Due Diligence ensures that requirements are delivered according to agreed priorities and in line with regulatory obligations, HSBC Group standards and internal policies. Also supports decision-making on Customer Due Diligence solutions and escalates issues, risks and dependencies when required. The role leads the implementation, governance, reporting and continuous improvement of Customer Due Diligence across Wealth and Personal Banking in the United Arab Emirates. Its purpose is to ensure that customer risks are properly understood and managed while HSBC meets its financial crime, regulatory and internal control obligations.
q: Financial-crime and Customer Due Diligence expertise Strong understanding of financial crime, Customer Due Diligence, AML/KYC activities, sanctions, counter-terrorist financing and proliferation-financing risks.
Banking and regulatory knowledge Knowledge of retail banking and financial services products, together with an understanding of the UAE regulatory environment and applicable Group requirements.
Leadership and change-management experience Experience creating or leading teams, managing reorganisations and implementing change in a financial-services or comparable environment.
Programme and project-management capability Proven ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise competing demands, plan effectively and deliver outcomes to deadlines.

Strong influencing and communication skills Ability to communicate and negotiate effectively at all organisational levels, build cross-functional relationships, explain risk-management requirements and influence stakeholders towards practical solutions.

3 year graduation degree is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and work permit. If your university certificate is from outside the UAE, up-to-date attestations and equivalency are also mandatory (Recognition of Higher Education Qualifications Issued Outside The UAE.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

We believe diversity brings benefits for our customers, our business and our people. Different ideas and perspectives help us innovate, manage risk and grow the business in a sustainable way. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

d: GAIA is seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Global Marketing Director to lead the marketing direction of its international restaurant portfolio.

Inspired by the landscapes of Greece and the rhythms of Mediterranean living, GAIA brings together authentic Greek-Mediterranean cuisine, warm hospitality and thoughtful design. With an established presence across leading international destinations and continued global expansion, the brand is entering an exciting phase of growth.

This role will lead the development and execution of GAIA's global marketing strategy, ensuring a distinctive and consistent brand identity while strengthening its presence across international markets. The successful candidate will combine strategic vision with hands-on leadership, bringing experience in luxury dining, lifestyle and international brand development.
q: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field.
Minimum 5+ years of experience in a senior marketing leadership position.
Previous experience within luxury hospitality, premium restaurants, lifestyle or high-end consumer brands.
Proven experience managing marketing across multiple brands, locations or international markets.
Strong understanding of luxury restaurant marketing, digital strategy, social media, PR, content creation and influencer partnerships.
Demonstrated experience leading and developing marketing teams.
Strong commercial understanding, with the ability to translate marketing initiatives into measurable business results.
Experience managing marketing budgets, agencies and external stakeholders.
Excellent communication, leadership and organisational skills.
Ability to operate in a fast-paced, international environment.
Willingness and flexibility to travel internationally as required.
The position will be based in the United Arab Emirates.
Regular international travel will be required to support GAIA's global locations, new openings and marketing initiatives.
